name: Kulicke & Soffa Industries Inc.
old_description: Kulicke and Soffa is a global leader in semiconductor assembly technology, advancing device performance across automotive, compute, industrial, memory and communications markets. Founded on innovation in 1951, K&S is uniquely positioned to overcome increasingly dynamic process challenges - creating and delivering long-term value by aligning technology with opportunity.
about:
Kulicke & Soffa Industries Inc. was founded in 1951 in Fort Washington, Pennsylvania. The company began as an innovator in semiconductor assembly technology and has since grown into a global supplier of equipment and solutions for the semiconductor packaging industry.

The company designs and manufactures semiconductor assembly equipment, including wire bonding, die bonding, thermocompression bonding, and ultrasonic assembly systems. Its product portfolio also encompasses advanced dispensing solutions, aftermarket products, repair and refurbishment services, and spare parts supply. K&S operates globally, serving customers across multiple continents with a focus on advanced packaging technologies such as fluxless thermocompression bonding and co-packaged optics assembly.

K&S serves customers in the automotive, compute, industrial, memory, and communications markets. Its equipment is used by semiconductor manufacturers and assembly houses producing devices for applications ranging from automotive electronics to high-performance computing and artificial intelligence infrastructure.

Founded on a commitment to innovation, the company emphasizes aligning technology with opportunity to overcome dynamic process challenges. Recent recognitions include a SEMI Award for North America for breakthrough fluxless thermocompression bonding technology, underscoring its focus on pioneering capabilities that redefine semiconductor assembly and packaging.
